title: QGB-W$k$NN: Quantum Granular-Ball Learning for Robust Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.05952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nearest-neighbor classification is widely used in machine learning, yet existing methods often suffer from low computational efficiency and limited robustness in noisy environments. To jointly address these challenges, this paper proposes an efficient and reliable weighted $K$-nearest neighbor classification framework based on quantum granular balls, termed QGB-W$k$NN. The proposed framework improves computational efficiency by integrating quantum-enhanced granular-ball representation with hierarchical nearest-neighbor search, while enhancing classification reliability through a purity-aware weighted decision mechanism. Specifically, quantum-kernel granular balls are constructed to reduce retrieval redundancy and strengthen nonlinear feature representation under limited quantum resources. A granular-ball purity-guided HNSW optimization strategy is developed to exploit structural reliability for hierarchical graph construction during neig

translated_title: QGB-W$k$NN：基于量子颗粒球学习的鲁棒分类方法
translated_abstract: 近邻分类在机器学习中被广泛应用，然而现有方法往往存在计算效率低以及在噪声环境中鲁棒性有限的问题。为了同时应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于量子颗粒球的高效且可靠的加权K近邻分类框架，称为QGB-W$k$NN。该框架通过将量子增强的颗粒球表示与层次化近邻搜索相结合来提升计算效率，同时通过一种纯度感知的加权决策机制来增强分类的可靠性。具体而言，构建量子核颗粒球以减少检索冗余，并在有限量子资源下强化非线性特征表示。此外，开发了一种由颗粒球纯度引导的HNSW优化策略，在近邻搜索的层次图构建过程中利用结构可靠性信息……
tldr: 本文提出基于量子颗粒球的加权K近邻分类框架QGB-W$k$NN，通过量子增强颗粒球表示、层次化近邻搜索和纯度感知加权决策机制，同时提升了计算效率与噪声环境下的分类鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QGB-W$k$NN, a quantum granular-ball-based weighted K-nearest neighbor classification framework that jointly improves computational efficiency and robustness in noisy environments through quantum-enhanced granular-ball representation, hierarchical nearest-neighbor search, and a purity-aware weighted decision mechanism.
